items.section: This morning in Waynesville — LEAD ITEM #1 (editor's instruction)
items.text: Make Spartan football the first lead item: Waynesville plays the Region 20 semifinal at Graham Local (Graham High School, St. Paris) tonight at 7:00 PM, after beating Preble Shawnee 35-13 in Round 2.
